era_zh: 新石器时代 · 仰韶文化

background.zh: 这是一件五千多年前的陶器。它被塑造成一只雄鹰的样子，粗壮的双腿撑起厚实的躯干，成为一件盛放谷物的容器。
background.en: This is a piece of pottery made more than five thousand years ago. It was shaped like a standing eagle, its two sturdy legs supporting a thick body that also served as a container for grain.

transcript.zh: 五千年前的匠人，并没有把这件器物做成一个简单的罐子。
transcript.en: The craftsman of five thousand years ago did not simply make this vessel into a plain jar.

transcript.zh: 他选择了一只鹰的姿态：低头，弓背，双腿分立，仿佛随时准备起飞。
transcript.en: Instead, he chose the posture of an eagle: head lowered, back arched, legs planted apart, as if ready to take flight at any moment.

transcript.zh: 这不仅是一件实用的容器，更是先民对力量与飞翔的想象。
transcript.en: This was not only a practical container, but also an expression of early people's imagination about strength and flight.

transcript.zh: 泥土经过烈火淬炼，才能变成如此坚硬的陶器。
transcript.en: Only after clay has been tempered by intense fire can it become pottery this hard.

transcript.zh: 今天，它安静地立在展柜中，却依然让人感受到那份原始的力量。
transcript.en: Today, it stands quietly in a display case, yet it still lets people feel that primal sense of power.

sentence_patterns.pattern: not only A, but also B
sentence_patterns.zh_explanation: 用来强调事物具有超出预期的双重属性，语气比单独说 A and B 更强。
sentence_patterns.en_explanation: Used to emphasize that something has two qualities, where the second is more surprising or important than expected. Stronger emphasis than a plain 'and'.
sentence_patterns.example_from_transcript: This was not only a practical container, but also an expression of early people's imagination about strength and flight.
extra_examples: The museum is not only a place to see artifacts, but also a place to learn history.
She is not only a translator, but also a published poet.

sentence_patterns.zh_explanation: 'as if' 引导一个虚拟的比较，表示看起来像是某种情况，但并非事实。
sentence_patterns.en_explanation: 'as if' introduces a hypothetical comparison — describing how something looks or seems, without claiming it is literally true.
sentence_patterns.example_from_transcript: legs planted apart, as if ready to take flight at any moment.
extra_examples: He stood still, as if he had seen a ghost.
The old bridge creaked, as if it might collapse at any moment.

sentence_patterns.pattern: Only after X can Y (inversion for emphasis)
sentence_patterns.zh_explanation: 当 'only after...' 放在句首时，主句需要部分倒装（助动词提前），用于强调条件的必要性。
sentence_patterns.en_explanation: When 'only after...' opens a sentence, the main clause uses partial inversion (auxiliary verb moves before the subject), emphasizing that the condition is necessary.
sentence_patterns.example_from_transcript: Only after clay has been tempered by intense fire can it become pottery this hard.
extra_examples: Only after years of practice can a student write with true fluency.
Only after the flood receded could the villagers return home.

sentence_patterns.zh_explanation: 'yet' 用于连接两个存在对比的分句，比 'but' 更书面、更强调转折。
sentence_patterns.en_explanation: 'yet' connects two contrasting clauses; it feels more formal and emphatic than 'but'.
sentence_patterns.example_from_transcript: it stands quietly in a display case, yet it still lets people feel that primal sense of power.
extra_examples: The room was small, yet it felt warm and welcoming.
He had little formal education, yet he became a brilliant engineer.

vocabulary.example_zh: 这件陶器已有五千年历史。
vocabulary.example_en: This piece of pottery is five thousand years old.
It is both a sculpture and a container.
The eagle's posture is full of strength.

vocabulary.example_zh: 泥土经过淬炼才能成陶。
vocabulary.example_en: Clay must be tempered before it becomes pottery.

vocabulary.example_zh: 它带着一种原始的力量。
vocabulary.example_en: It carries a kind of primal power.

sentences.zh: 这件文物不仅造型独特，更蕴含着古人的智慧。
sentences.reference_en: This artifact is not only unique in shape, but also embodies the wisdom of ancient people.

sentences.zh: 他站在那里一动不动，仿佛在等待什么。
sentences.reference_en: He stood there without moving, as if waiting for something.

sentences.zh: 只有反复打磨，这块玉才能变得如此光滑。
sentences.reference_en: Only after repeated polishing could this piece of jade become so smooth.

sentences.zh: 展厅里很安静，然而每一件展品都在诉说着历史。
sentences.reference_en: The gallery is quiet, yet every exhibit is telling a story of history.
